'''Lenk''' was a member of the crew of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] vessel ''[[Black Ice/Legends|Black Ice]]''. He was [[Death/Legends|killed]] during the [[Battle for Black Ice|assault]] on the ''Black Ice'' by [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] forces.<ref name="Black Ice" />
